Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 04-Jan-2026 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY 2026  
  Advanced Software Engineering [IT_4417]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                 Analyze how component-based software development enhances software reuse and scalability.             (5)  
  Illustrate your answer with an example of a layered software architecture used in enterprise  
  A)            applications  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)            Compare the Agile process model with the traditional Waterfall approach in terms of flexibility,      (5)  
  iteration, and customer feedback. Discuss how Agile supports rapid change management.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                 Examine how organizational structures and governance policies influence the implementation of         (5)  
  security and dependability within large-scale software systems. Support your discussion with  
  A)            relevant organizational models.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  B)            Break down the concept of sociotechnical resilience and analyze its implications for the design of    (5)  
  fault-tolerant systems, considering both human and technical subsystems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
3)                 Analyze the role of security testing in the software assurance process. How do strategies like        (5)  
  penetration testing uncover vulnerabilities?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)            Explain the Component-Based Software Engineering process model. Compare it with traditional           (5)  
  software development life cycles in terms of reuse and integration.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                 Evaluate the role of Component-Based Software Engineering (CBSE) in agile development                 (5)  
  environments. Is CBSE compatible with iterative delivery and continuous refactoring principles?  
  A)            Justify with suitable examples.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)            Analyze the architectural layers of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and their role in service     (5)  
  orchestration and interoperability within distributed enterprise systems.  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
5)                        Explain the effectiveness of system operation and evolution strategies in maintaining long-lived    (5)  
  software systems. Evaluate how re-engineering, refactoring, and maintenance ensure architectural  
  A)                stability.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  B)                Compare architectural patterns used in real-time systems. How do these patterns address timing,     (5)  
  concurrency, and synchronization constraints using AI  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
